class.name: VirtualGeometryMesh
class.brief_description: A virtual geometry model root and its material bindings.
class.description: Stores validated VGMR root metadata and a relative page-container filename. Detailed pages are not loaded or expanded by this resource. The standard Mesh array API cannot expand its geometry; collision and navigation use separately prepared resources. This build implements metadata storage and serialization only. GPU installation and rendering are not connected. Requesting a rendering RID reports an error and returns an invalid RID.

method.name: get_geometry_data
method.description: Returns root bytes, the page-container filename and byte count, and material bindings. Changing the returned dictionary or byte array does not replace this resource's metadata. Material resources themselves remain shared.

method.name: has_geometry
method.description: Returns whether root metadata and bindings have been configured. This does not indicate that page bytes exist or that GPU rendering is ready.

method.name: set_geometry_data
method.description: Accepts exactly four fields: [code]root[/code] (VGMR PackedByteArray), [code]container[/code] (a local lowercase filename ending in [code].vgp[/code]), [code]container_bytes[/code] (positive integer), and [code]materials[/code] (one Material or null per dense root slot). Root bytes are limited to 64 MiB and decoded metadata to 256 MiB. Configuration checks metadata without reading the container or hashing files. Failure preserves the entire previous configuration. Call on the main thread.
